title: The Fragrant Fern (U Tyrkhang Iewbih)
cultural_context: Celebration of the wild fragrant mountain fern of Meghalaya, known for its sweet scent in rocky streams.
lyrics_khasi:
U tyrkhang u iewbih
Ha thwei maw ba jylliew,
Khlem da pyrto la ka nam,
U pyniwbih ia u briew;
Ki sla ba jyrngam
Ki pdiang ia ka um,
U sngewbha tang ban im
Ha pneh jong u lum.

Kumta to ngin long,
Khlem ka sarong pyrthei,
Ban pynphriang ka jingbha
Sha ki kur ki kha;
Wat ha ka jaka ba rieh,
La ka hok to ai kan paw,
Kum u tyrkhang ba iwbih
Ha syndah u maw.
lyrics_english:
The fragrant wild fern smells sweet
Beside deep mossy boulders,
Without boasting of its name,
It imparts sweetness to the wanderer;
Its emerald fronds
Drink in the mountain dew,
Content simply to live
In the lap of the high hill.

Even thus let us be,
Free from worldly vanity,
Spreading goodness and virtue
Unto all our kin;
Even in secluded paths,
Let righteousness shine forth,
Like the fragrant wild fern
Beside the mountain stone.
